title: Real-time Updates
seo: Real-time dashboard updates with live data
meta: Live numbers and instant updates on the screens where speed matters, built safely. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
overview: Some numbers should not wait for a page refresh, such as new orders, active users or a job that is still running. We add live updates to the parts of your dashboard that need them, using WebSockets or server-sent events. We keep it calm: values update smoothly, reconnect after a lost connection, and the rest of the page stays light so it does not use up your server.

faq: No. Many numbers are fine updating every minute, which costs less to run. We tell you honestly which panels need live updates and which do not before we build.
Server-sent events for simple one-way updates, and WebSockets when users also send data back. If you use Firebase, Supabase or Pusher, we use those instead.
Will it raise my hosting costs?
Live connections use some server resources. We keep messages small and share what to expect for your size. Hosting is billed by your provider and is separate from our price.
Can you add this to an app that is already live?
Yes. We add it panel by panel on a test copy first, then switch it on once you have approved it. Your current screens keep working during the change.
